description: SingLinkVPN is a free VPN for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and Linux, with open-source tools, security audits, no-logs verification and Sola protocol research.
h1: SingLinkVPN Free VPN & Open-Source VPN Project
hero: Daily free VPN data, official apps for every major platform, open-source VPN projects, security-audit evidence, no-logs verification and protocol research.
aboutTitle: Free VPN for phones and computers
about: SingLinkVPN provides daily free VPN data for mobile and desktop users. This GitHub project brings together official downloads, open-source tools, technical documentation, security audits, no-logs verification and Sola protocol research.
downloads: Official platform pages provide the latest SingLinkVPN apps, installation instructions and release information for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux and Apple TV.
free: The SingLinkVPN Free Plan provides 200 MB of free VPN data per day on mobile and 500 MB per day on desktop. Eligible desktop campaigns provide up to 1 GB per day.
audit: SingLinkVPN desktop 2.5 completed a third-party security audit covering macOS 2.5.7 build 3065 and Windows 2.5.8 build 3077, with a published score of 100/100. The signed report and integrity records are available in the audit repository.
noLogs: SingLinkVPN passed the 2026 no-logs verification with a reference date of 29 July 2026. The signed report and verification files are publicly available in the dedicated evidence repository.
tech: Sola is SingLink's next-generation VPN transport protocol rebuilt from the SingLink 2.0 architecture. Core development and first-phase testing are complete, and the project has entered protocol-security and implementation review.
openSource: Phase 2 of the SingLinkVPN open-source project was released on 12 November 2026. After an internal security audit, SingLinkLabs published the first-generation SingLink protocol and the first-generation SingLinkVPN client in two Apache-2.0 repositories, and the open-source hub links both.
openSourceProtocol: SingLink/1, the first-generation version of the SingLink protocol, written from scratch in Go: signed, device-bound access passes, inner end-to-end encryption, hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 post-quantum key exchange, and replay and active-probe resistance. The internal security audit recorded 31 findings, every High and Medium finding is fixed, and a third-party audit is planned.
openSourceApp: Built with Flutter and Go on the SingLink Protocol for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS: a device-wide VPN on mobile and a system proxy on desktop.
openSourceHub: Phase overview, public documentation, research data, security materials and benchmarks in one place.
openSourceLineage: The SingLink protocol has evolved from SingLinkVPN's early versions and SingLink Beta to today's SingLink 2.0. The open-source first-generation SingLink protocol and first-generation SingLinkVPN client carry forward SingLinkVPN's long-standing design principles: account-based permissions, device binding and security by design.
openSourceBoundary: The official apps and protocol have since moved to a new-generation architecture (SingLink 2.0); for security reasons these latest versions, together with servers, payment and nodes, are not yet fully public, so this release includes only code that poses no security risk. The open-source plan continues, and later phases will publish more after security review. Please report vulnerabilities privately as described in each repository's SECURITY.md.
verify: Machine-readable project data, source links, release dates and automated checks keep downloads, Free Plan information, audit evidence and protocol status easy to find and verify.
trust: SingLinkVPN combines daily free VPN data, broad platform support, public security evidence, no-logs verification, open-source projects and active VPN protocol research.
